propositions: A Jira Data Center transport must be built on the maintained pycontribs/jira library behind an opt-in [jira-datacenter] extra, with lazy import to preserve rebar's dependency-free contract
The transport must reject non-https base_url with ConfigError unless allow_insecure=true, never disable TLS verification, and support internal CA bundles via ca_bundle config key

Every TicketTransport/SupportsLinks/SupportsComments/SupportsAbsenceProbe method must return raw payload shapes (not jira.Issue objects) matching the existing _jira_shape_contract, with live test coverage against the J5 harness
The DC backend must self-register in adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves after import, raising BackendRegistryError not KeyError when unregistered
HTTP errors must not be retried (exactly 1 attempt); connection/socket timeouts must be retried with 2s/5s backoff; unknown assignees must raise BackendAssigneeNotFoundError

The NameIdentity user-search resolver must wire the DC search_users lookup to return authoritative identities for real users and (None, True, False) for unknown users, enabling NameIdentity to reach convergence on the apply path where BackendAssigneeNotFoundError is raised
